title: Hamnet
author: Maggie O'Farrell
summary: In late sixteenth-century Warwickshire, the story follows Agnes, a healer, and her husband, a Latin tutor who becomes a playwright. It centres on the death of their young son Hamnet.
readIf: you like lyrical historical fiction focused on love, family and grief.
skipIf: you want a book about Shakespeare's career or find child loss unbearable.
